description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy and correlation of different machine learning models in processing sentence embeddings. The vertical axis represents the accuracy and correlation values, ranging from 0 to 1, with a linear scale. The horizontal axis lists five different model configurations: Single-task baseline, Baseline with Adaptive Dropout, Unsupervised SimCSE, Supervised SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE. Each model configuration has three bars representing Sentiment Accuracy (light yellow), STS Correlation (pink), and Paraphrase Accuracy (light blue). The Sentiment Accuracy bars are consistently the shortest across all models, while the Paraphrase Accuracy bars are the tallest, indicating higher values. The STS Correlation bars vary in height, with the 2-Tier SimCSE model showing the highest correlation. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
